title: Service Test 58: Ice maker heater & thermistor

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool/KitchenAid ACU French Door Refrigerator (W11509412A, ~27 cu ft)
source.oemTestTitle: Ref. Compartment Ice Maker Heater Activation and Thermistor

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating. For live voltage checks, verify controls are off, use proper PPE, and disconnect power after measurements.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Service Diagnostics
steps.body: Service Diagnostics entered at step 01. Press SW5/SW4 to navigate to the test number for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press SW5 to move to the next step in the sequence. Press SW4 to back up.

steps.title: Navigate to Service Test 58
steps.body: In Service Diagnostics Mode, press SW5 to advance until the dispenser display shows 58. Press SW4 to go back. Amber Order Filter = step number; red Replace Filter = step result.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Service Test 58 — Ice maker heater and thermistor

steps.title: Toggle mold heater
steps.body: Press SW3 to activate ice maker heater and toggle on/off. Digit 1: 0=heater off, 1=heater on. Digit 2 thermistor: 0=warmer than harvest, 1=cooler, 2=open, 3=short.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press SW3 to activate ice maker heater and toggle on/off. Digit 1: 0=heater off, 1=heater on. Digit 2 thermistor: 0=warmer than harvest, 1=cooler, 2=open, 3=short.

steps.title: Mold thermistor state
steps.body: With heater on, what does digit 2 show for thermistor state?
steps.sourceExcerpt: With heater on, what does digit 2 show for thermistor state?

steps.title: Bench IM thermistor ohms
steps.body: Disconnect power. Measure ice maker mold thermistor at P7-1/P7-2.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Measure ice maker mold thermistor at P7-1/P7-2.

steps.title: Ice maker mold thermistor
steps.body: 2700 Ω ±5% @ 77°F — same R/T chart as cabinet thermistors.
steps.sourceExcerpt: 2700 Ω ±5% @ 77°F — same R/T chart as cabinet thermistors.

steps.title: Replace IM thermistor or module
steps.oemOutcome: Ice maker mold thermistor open, short, or out of range (E5).

steps.title: Heater and thermistor verified
steps.oemOutcome: Service test 58 and mold thermistor ohms verified.
